 Charles Leclerc becomes a father as birth of baby announced
 Charles Leclerc has become a father, with the Ferrari driver announcing the birth of his baby daughter on social media.
 RN365 Staff
 4 November 1:45PM
 0 comments 
 0
 Add us as preferred source 
 Article 
 To news overview 
 © XPB Images
 Charles Leclerc has announced the birth of his first child, a daughter named Bianca, with his wife, Alexandra.
 The Ferrari driver confirmed the news on social media, revealing that Bianca was born on Tuesday, 3 November, 2026.
 The announcement was accompanied by a photograph showing the newborn's legs and feet, dressed in pink trousers and cream booties.
 The arrival marks a significant personal milestone for the 29-year-old Monegasque, who married Alexandra in a private ceremony in Monaco in February this year.
 The couple confirmed they were expecting their first child in August, having previously kept the pregnancy largely out of the public eye.
 Leclerc had spoken about his impending fatherhood during the United States Grand Prix weekend last month, insisting he did not expect to miss a race despite the approaching birth.
 However, he acknowledged that he could make adjustments to his travel schedule to spend more time with his family.
 "I don't think I'll miss a race, but obviously I'll do absolutely everything to be at home as much as possible in between those races," Leclerc said at the time.
 "So, I might arrive a little bit late. But I will be doing the races on Sunday."
 The birth comes during a busy period in the F1 calendar, with Leclerc preparing for this weekend's São Paulo Grand Prix at Interlagos.
 The Ferrari driver is currently fifth in the drivers' championship as the 2026 season approaches its conclusion, with four rounds remaining.
 The entire team at RacingNews365 wishes Charles and Alexandra the warmest congratulations on their wonderful news!
